### **ABHAYAGIRI BUDDHIST MONASTERY**

**16201 TOMKI ROAD**
**REDWOOD VALLEY, CA 95470 Tel: (707)485-1630 Fax: (707)317-0043 E-mail: vihara@abhayagiri.org**
March 10, 2020
To whom it may concern:
I am writing in support of Andy McGuire for his intention to participate in the The Mindfulness Meditation Teacher Certification Program under the guidance of Jack Kornfield and Tara Brach. I have known Andy for over ten years and recognize him as a sincere practitioner who has been affiliated with Abhayagiri Buddhist Monastery all this time. He has been joining in retreats, teachings events and helping the monastery on a consistent basis all this time. He has also been close to other places and teachers that are affiliated with Spirit Rock all this time as well. He has expressed the interest in wishing to help others and this training would be of support for him to further his interests in reaching out to others and being of service to them.
I fully support Andy’s aspiration to learn from this program and hope that he is able to do so. I may be reached by phone at (707) 485-1630, or by email via vihara@abhayagiri.org.
Sincerely,
Pasanno Bhikkhu (Guiding Elder)
